t: Titan TTB1333GRD 230mm corded angle grinder delivers high-power cutting and grinding for heavy-duty materials. Suitable for metalworkers and builders, this robust tool handles demanding workshop and site applications. The powerful 2000W motor features fan cooling to prevent overheating during prolonged use. Equipped with a 3-position side handle, and tool-free guard adjustment, providing enhanced control and quick setup changes. The spindle lock makes disc changes fast and straightforward, reducing downtime. Dust-sealed bearings and an all-metal gearbox ensure long-term durability. Supplied with auxiliary handle and guard.
